title: One far-end speaker on a bad connection
description: Two far-end speakers: Lena on a clean line, Joel on a bad one — telephone band, a starved 6 kbit/s codec and lost packets — with a noisy far-end mix.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: THIS WAS WHAT DID THE MISCHIEF SO FAR AS THE RUNNING AWAY WAS CONCERNED

utterances.speaker: Joel
utterances.text: ONCE FAIRLY A WING HOWEVER HE WHEELED AND MADE BACK HURRIEDLY FOR HIS PERCH

utterances.speaker: Owen
utterances.text: OUT IN THE WOODS STOOD A NICE LITTLE FIR TREE

utterances.speaker: Joel
utterances.text: IN DESPAIR HE HURLED HIMSELF DOWNWARD TOO SOON

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: JOHN WESLEY COMBASH JACOB TAYLOR AND THOMAS EDWARD SKINNER

utterances.speaker: Owen
utterances.text: BUT THIS WAS WHAT THE TREE COULD NOT BEAR TO HEAR

utterances.speaker: Joel
utterances.text: THE GREAT HAWK FOLLOWED HURRIEDLY TO RETRIEVE HIS PREY FROM THE GROUND

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: AS USUAL NOTHING WAS DONE IN THE WAY OF PUNISHMENT

utterances.speaker: Owen
utterances.text: IN AUTUMN THE WOOD CUTTERS ALWAYS CAME AND FELLED SOME OF THE LARGEST TREES

utterances.speaker: Joel
utterances.text: THE HAWK ALIGHTED ON THE DEAD BRANCH AND SAT UPRIGHT MOTIONLESS AS IF SURPRISED

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: I NEVER KNEW OF BUT ONE MAN WHO COULD EVER PLEASE HIM

utterances.speaker: Owen
utterances.text: REJOICE IN THY GROWTH SAID THE SUNBEAMS

utterances.speaker: Joel
utterances.text: ALMOST INSTANTLY HE WAS FORCED TO THE TOP

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: SUBSTANTIALLY THIS WAS JACOB'S UNVARNISHED DESCRIPTION OF HIS MASTER AND MISTRESS

utterances.speaker: Owen
utterances.text: WERE I BUT ALREADY ON THE CART
